name: Shenzhen Jame Technology Corp., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Jame Technology Corp., Ltd., established in 2006 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, is a global enterprise that develops, designs, manufactures, and sells accessories for smart mobile devices and other electronics. Their product line primarily features protective cases for items such as mobile phones, tablets, and wearable technology, along with various watch straps.
